_comment: Trading holidays, by segment and ISO date. Read by services/market_session.py.
'equity' gates NSE and BSE derivatives (NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, FINNIFTY,
MIDCPNIFTY, SENSEX, BANKEX). 'commodity' gates MCX (CRUDEOIL), which trades
on several equity holidays and in an evening-only session on some others.
An evening-only day is deliberately NOT modelled: it is listed as a trading
day and the broker remains the authority on the exact minute.
MAINTENANCE: these lists must be refreshed each calendar year from the NSE
and MCX holiday circulars. A missing or unreadable file degrades to 'every
weekday is a trading day' — the behaviour before the calendar existed — so
a stale file loses the clear message, never the ability to trade.
The 2026 dates below are seeded from the published NSE/MCX calendars. VERIFY
them against the exchange circular before the year starts; exchanges add and
move dates (and a Muhurat session is a trading day, not a holiday).
